verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents an official per-project MCP server that gives AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code Copilot a live connection to a project's API spec and documentation. MCP Metrics records every tool call, and a probe confirmed the documented MCP page. Missing for 10: details on connection setup, authentication and the exposed tool list; independent or hands-on corroboration; evidence of an MCP server for managing ReadMe projects themselves rather than only reading published docs.
